drums.description: Indie rock, 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature, The track features a dry, acoustic drum kit with a prominent snare crack and a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern, A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated two-note riff emphasizing the off-beats, A melodic electric bass follows the kick drum pattern with a rounded, warm tone, A second electric guitar with light overdrive enters later, playing sustained power chords and melodic lead lines with moderate reverb, The arrangement is minimalist and rhythmic, focusing on the interplay between the percussive guitar riff and the steady drum pocket Publish
